alt: The inference stack as layered slabs, top to bottom: serving engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang); continuous batching, drawn as request lanes where a finished request frees its slot for a new one; Flash Attention, drawn as a score matrix streamed tile by tile into on-chip memory; the paged KV cache, drawn as three sequences mapped onto scattered memory blocks; quantization, drawn as one weight at 16, 8, and 4 bits; and the GPU with its memory stacks. Numbered squares give the order to apply them: batching, attention kernel, FP8, paged KV cache, then INT8 or 4-bit.
caption: Apply the levers in the numbered order. Continuous batching moves throughput 10–20× on its own; the article covers each lever's trade-off.
